file(GLOB NET_SRCS "src/*.cpp")

# On the host the link backend is the process's own loopback, so the WiFi
# state machine, mDNS, NTP and the HTTP downloader are not built at all — the
# relay they share is.
if(IDF_TARGET STREQUAL "linux")
    set(NET_SRCS
        "src/net_relay.cpp"
        "src/tls.cpp"
        "src/host/net_host.cpp"
        "src/host/services_host.cpp")
endif()

# Cross-straddle REQUIRES come from staging/components/<repo>/spangap_requires.cmake,
# auto-generated by spangap-inside from this straddle's requires:/optional_requires:
# intersected with the staged set. The on-device Net → WiFi Settings pane lives
# in esp-idf/conditional/spangap-lcd/, compiled only when the lcd straddle is
# staged, and registers via the when:-gated netLcdRegister init hook — no #if
# anywhere. The Net → mDNS pane is declarative (generated from settings:).
set(_NET_IDF_REQ esp_event nvs_flash mbedtls esp_timer json)
if(NOT IDF_TARGET STREQUAL "linux")
    list(APPEND _NET_IDF_REQ esp_wifi esp_netif lwip esp_http_client espressif__mdns)
endif()

include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/spangap_requires.cmake)
idf_component_register(
    SRCS ${NET_SRCS}
        ${SPANGAP_CONDITIONAL_SRCS}
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include" ${SPANGAP_CONDITIONAL_INCLUDE_DIRS}
    # net_priv.h — what the relay and a link backend share, and nothing outside
    # this straddle's own sources.
    PRIV_INCLUDE_DIRS "src"
    REQUIRES
        ${SPANGAP_REQUIRES}
        ${_NET_IDF_REQ}
)
